_comment: GENERATED FILE - do not hand-edit. Groups of functions whose AST shape is identical, i.e. the same code differing only in names/constants/addresses - jump-table expansions or templated source instantiated many times. 'structural' shape (node kinds only) defines a family; 'semantic_variants' counts how many distinct call-sequences the family contains, where 1 means a true template instantiation. Families with fewer than --min-stmts statements are segregated into 'trivial_shape_groups' and NEVER used as classification evidence: at that size every one-line setter matches every other one, so a shared shape asserts nothing. Nothing here merges or rewrites files; each function is a real separately-addressable function in flash.
